searchText: Is this true? And is there any place I can read more about this feature? https://trent.mirror.xyz/82eyq_NXZzzqFmCNXiKJgSdayf6omCW7BgDQIneyPoA “Fourth, ETH priority fees that currently go to miners will instead go to a validator-controlled address on the execution layer. This means the ETH is immediately liquid. Given that full withdrawals of staked ETH will only go live in the Shanghai upgrade later next year, this is a significant improvement for validators with locked-up capital.” I can't speak for <@420951281910284289> in that post, the first part is certainly true: tips will go to validators and you can experience that right now in the merge testnets in <#892088344438255616> . The second part is not clear to me. There are a number of EIPs that seen to be agreed upon and that are expected to be in Shanghai. I haven't seen any commitments for withrawals though yes, validators will get tips that currently go to miners before withdrawals are enabled

Is this true? And is there any place I can read more about this feature? https://trent.mirror.xyz/82eyq_NXZzzqFmCNXiKJgSdayf6omCW7BgDQIneyPoA
“Fourth, ETH priority fees that currently go to miners will instead go to a validator-controlled address on the execution layer. This means the ETH is immediately liquid. Given that full withdrawals of staked ETH will only go live in the Shanghai upgrade later next year, this is a significant improvement for validators with locked-up capital.”
